content:
Chapter 116 It'S Not That I Won'T Give It To You

At this time, Lu Xue was still immersed in sadness and suddenly noticed the movement outside the door.

"I didn't say it, don't,"

Lu Xue was about to speak, but suddenly she was stunned.

Looking at the familiar face in front of him, Lu Xue couldn't believe it.

Could it be that I have cried for too long and had hallucinations?

Thinking of this, Lu Xue raised her hand and rubbed her eyes.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun laughed out loud, then stepped forward to wipe the tears from Lu Xue’s cheeks, and said softly: “Xiaoxue, don’t cry, mom is back.”

Hearing this, Lu Xue's tears became more and more.

Staring at Yan Lingyun's eyes, Lu Xue said in a straight voice: "Mom, why did you leave me and my dad?"

This is not only a problem that Lu Daosheng has always been, but also hers.

But she never said it.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, Yan Lingyun's heart became more and more bitter, and at the same time, she also secretly felt that she must compensate Lu Daosheng and Lu Xue for their thoughts in the future.

At this time, Lu Daosheng slowly walked in from outside the door.

"Xiaoxue, let me talk."

......

After a long time, Lu Xue threw herself into Yan Lingyun's arms.

The shackles that had been silent in the heart for many years were finally untied.

In this way, the family of three hugged each other tightly, and happiness was almost beyond words.

On the side, Ao Qing looked at all this silently with envious eyes, and finally had to sigh.

I have insomnia.

Your happiness has disturbed me.

From then on, the three of them lived a very happy life.

One day.

"Xiaoxue, Dad has given you a task."

Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue and suddenly said.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned.

Task?

"Dad, what's the mission?"

Lu Xue said in confusion.

Next to Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng smiled faintly and said, "Recently, there are some acquaintances who ascended from the Hongmeng Universe in the deserted city of the Wanling Realm. Please help me with my father."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded suddenly, and without thinking too much, she agreed directly.

"Okay dad, I'll go now."

On the side, Yan Lingyun said, "Xiaoxue, do you want your mother to accompany you?"

Lu Xue was about to speak, but Lu Daosheng said, "Xiaoxue is so big, there is no need to accompany her anymore. Let her go by herself, and also think it is to exercise her."

What's more, what accidents can happen in the world of all spirits.

And Ao Qing followed.

Immediately, Lu Xue left alone.

After Lu Xue left, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly, then smiled and said, "Lingyun, you haven't drunk with me for a long time."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun immediately gave him a blank look and said softly: "I just said it's no good for you to send Xiaoxue away."

But she did not refuse Lu Daosheng.

In the blink of an eye, a large table of wine jars appeared in front of you out of thin air.

"Lingyun, we will not return until we are drunk."

"Okay, then come."

......

"Well, Daosheng, why is your wine so powerful?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun's pretty face was already red and she was dizzy. She lay on the table and looked at Lu Daosheng, and she had already seen her figures.

And Lu Daosheng was not much better, and he was almost unable to stand firm in the battle.

This wine is naturally what the system wants, and it is definitely a good product.

"Haha, Lingyun, I haven't seen you for so many years, you won't be able to drink me even if you drink."

At this time, Lu Daosheng smiled and said provocatively.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun snorted lightly and said, "Who, who can say it, come on, continue."

Then Yan Lingyun, who was unwilling to admit defeat, picked up a can of wine jar and drank it.

On the side, Lu Daosheng was the same.

After a moment.

Plop ~

Yan Lingyun could no longer hold on and knocked her head on the table.

Lu Daosheng was not much better. Seeing his consciousness gradually blurred, Lu Daosheng hurriedly said with the last bit of consciousness: "System, hurry up, hang me up."

Buzz —

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng felt a comfortable warmth flowing slowly in his body.

In less than a moment, Lu Daosheng felt refreshed and did not look like he was drunk at all.

Turning his head and looking at Yan Lingyun, who was already confused, Lu Daosheng smiled.

"Lingyun, you drink too much, don't blame me."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng walked to Yan Lingyun, picked him up by the waist, and slowly walked into the room.

The next moment, a barrier suddenly appeared from the room.

In the room.

Looking at Yan Lingyun, who was blushing with a proud figure and almost mature appearance, Lu Daosheng immediately breathed rapidly.

[That, host, don't you feel guilty?]

At this time, the system suddenly reminded.

Hearing the system, Lu Daosheng said seriously:

"System, what are you saying? This is my wife. It's natural to do such a thing."

System: Host, I didn’t expect you to be such a person.

Soon, a heavy breathing sounded in the room.

(The process is omitted)

During this sleep, Yan Lingyun had a very uncomfortable nightmare.

I dreamed that I had sunk into the sea without any strength to resist. I finally floated to the surface of the water and grabbed a driftwood, but the driftwood actually bites people.

It hurts her bite.

After a while, Yan Lingyun finally woke up in a daze.

Immediately, Yan Lingyun felt a little uncomfortable all over.

"Hiss~ It's so uncomfortable. I can't drink so much next time."

"Um?"

"Ah!!! Lu Daosheng!!!"

Yan Lingyun looked at herself in disbelief, quickly got up and put on her clothes, then glared at Lu Daosheng with a blushing face.

Hearing the movement, Lu Daosheng also woke up. When he saw Yan Lingyun, he became angry. Lu Daosheng was also a little guilty, but he still smiled and said, "Haha, Lingyun, you are awake."

Seeing Lu Daosheng like this, Yan Lingyun gritted her teeth and said, "Don't pretend to be garlic for me, you are taking advantage of others' danger!"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng pretended to be angry and said, "Lingyun, what are you saying, we are husband and wife."

It's all an old couple.

Children can make soy sauce.

Suddenly, Yan Lingyun was speechless and was silent for a moment. Yan Lingyun snorted softly, "Then you can't take advantage of my failure to respond, I, I'm not not giving it to you."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked ecstatic.

The next moment, a figure rushed directly at Yan Lingyun.

"Ah!! You, wait."

"What, Lingyun, you are not lying to me, right?"

"No, no, I'm going to be on it."

......

A few days later.

"Dad, I'm back!"

Lu Xue returned to the city lord's mansion with a happy expression.

"Oh? Xiaoxue, I'll be back so soon."

When Lu Xue saw him, Lu Daosheng immediately smiled.

Lu Xue nodded and was about to say something, but suddenly noticed Lu Daosheng's face.

"Oh? Dad, why do I feel like you suddenly become so haggard?"

Lu Xue said in confusion.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked embarrassed, coughed lightly, and quickly changed the subject: "There are a lot of things in the city recently, but my dad just didn't have a good rest. By the way, how are you doing?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue didn't think much and said directly: "Oh, I have arranged them, it is definitely the best treatment, so don't worry."
